title: US tightens export rules on advanced AI chips to China
text: The US Commerce Department announced new export restrictions on advanced AI accelerators to China on Monday. The rules require licenses for shipments of high-end data-center GPUs made by NVIDIA and AMD. Analysts said NVIDIA could lose a meaningful share of its data-center revenue from Chinese customers. AMD said it was reviewing the impact of the new rules on its MI-series accelerators. Foundry partner TSMC, which manufactures the affected chips, may see lower order volumes for advanced nodes.

model_output.event_summary: US imposes license requirements on exports of high-end AI accelerators to China, affecting NVIDIA and AMD; TSMC may see lower advanced-node orders.
